_help: Contact details of the warehouse. Fill them in, then run `node build.mjs`. An empty field shows a dashed 'to complete' slot (email, address) or is left out (phone). `url` is the public address of the site once it is online, e.g. https://magacinzapadnoevropski.com/ (docs/CNAME holds the same domain for GitHub Pages) (used for search engines and link previews). supabaseUrl and supabaseKey connect the price check and the orders: the project URL (https://<ref>.supabase.co) and its publishable key (sb_publishable_...), both safe to publish.
